Common rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): simple spots: darker slate spots in three sizes + little white dots; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Uncommon rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): a cream zigzag band with a dark green outline, lime spots in its bays, white dots; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Rare rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): two white bands edged in navy, ringed white dots between them, pale dots above and below; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Epic rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): a deep violet star band between two raised gold Neon trims (GlowTrim), white Neon 4-point stars (GlowStar), white / gold dots; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Legendary rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): a white-gold crown with eight points against a crimson velvet ring, Neon gold trim + point balls (GlowCrown), ruby / sapphire Neon gems (GlowRuby, GlowSapphire), cream filigree swags with pearls; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Mythic rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): flowing gradient bands (violet / plum foot, blush / pale cap), a Neon violet wave ribbon (GlowWave), eight teal Neon fiddlehead swirls (GlowSwirl), sparkles (GlowStar); Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Secret rarity egg (lobby-shop egglook A, painted, owner: more detail + VFX): night shell with a violet dusk, violet Neon cracks from the tip (GlowCrack) into a ring of magenta Neon runes (GlowRune), white Neon stars (GlowStar), pin-prick stars; Neon parts named Glow* are the VFX hooks; pivot bottom centre, attachment Center

Storm Altar return portal (lobby-shop portal C): standing charcoal voussoir ring 7 x 9.5 studs on a plinth, keystone with a navy sign board (text on SignFace), two cyan crystals, inner Neon rim + trim tinted Primary (the Return-gate green); attachments PortalCenter / SignFace / Pad

Storm Altar summon ring (lobby-shop portal C, spec 5.11 b; dresses StormAltar PortalGlow.GlowRing, which turns): 16 crystal-cyan Neon bars (GlowBar) with pale Neon ridges (GlowBarHeart) and chamfered ends, each in a straight charcoal stone collar (light lip, rounded corners, worn cells, a mason's tick), even 0.2-stud joints; bars on r 5.65, stone inside r 6.0 (clear of the Portal rim at 6.1); 11.8 x 0.8 x 11.8, pivot = the disc centre on the glow disc's top, attachment Center

Global leaderboard board on the south lawn (lobby-shop spec 5.10; dresses LobbyBoardBuilder's LobbyLeaderboard, Keep Face): a plank frame round an exact 16 x 13 opening (the navy Face stays a Part for the PlayerGui SurfaceGui), a plank back with two battens and a centre batten, brass corner caps, two planed timber posts on cream stone feet (wear: damp band, chipped corner, crack, moss), a stepped rose shingle roof with rafter tails and brass ridge caps, a gold trophy cup on the ridge; no light, no Neon; pivot ground centre, front -Z, attachment FaceCenter (0, 9.5, -0.2)
